messages:
sarah_support: FYI copied from customer ticket — bulk embeddings job started failing after they switched billing account. Getting a mix of 429s and sporadic 401s. They also saw a few 'dimension mismatch' errors. Pasting trimmed logs below.

sarah_support: ``ERROR 429: rate limit exceeded for /v1/embeddings - batch_id=42 size=1024
ERROR 401: invalid authentication for org=acct_XXXX
ERROR: embedding output length=1536 expected=1024 (dimension mismatch)``

sarah_support: Customer says they run 10k vectors in parallel with batch size ~512, using model=embed-large-v2. They didn't change client code except swapping billing org.

mike_sre: thanks — can you share the X-RateLimit-* headers from their 429 responses and the exact timestamp window? also curious whether their key got throttled by org or by project quota.

sarah_support: pasted header example from customer: ``X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1678901234``

jenn_research: dimension mismatch stands out. embed-large-v2 should return 1024 dims. 1536 suggests either a different model or an internal mismatch (model alias pointing to a different architecture). Did they specify model by alias or by full canonical name?

sarah_support: they used model param 'embed-large-v2' (no version hash).

ben_infra: deploy-bot shows a config rollout earlier today: `model-aliases.yml` updated at 2387652000 — possible alias flip. @deploy-bot can you confirm?

deploy-bot: roll 2387651987 completed by jenn_research — alias embed-large-v2 -> embed-large-v2-quantized-1536 (experimental).

mike_sre: ah — alias flip explains 1536. That explains dimension mismatch for clients expecting 1024. But why 429/401? two possible signals: 1) their billing org had a lower quota which triggered 429; 2) switching to quantized variant might route to a dedicated pool with tighter per-org concurrency.

ryan_billing: I looked up the customer's billing account. They accidentally pointed to a new org_id that only has trial credits and a low embedding quota (concurrency 60). Their previous org had reserved capacity. The 401s coincide with auth attempts using a legacy API key tied to the old org — looks like some calls hit old creds and get rejected intermittently during the swap.

ben_infra: repro plan: 1) reproduce alias mapping serving embed-large-v2 -> 1536 model, 2) run concurrent job with batch sizes 512*20 to hit concurrency. We'll capture X-RateLimit headers and SLO logs.

sarah_support: customer asked for quick mitigation — what to tell them?

jenn_research: tell them to temporarily set model explicitly to embed-large-v2@v1 (the canonical pin) so dims stay 1024, and reduce client concurrency to 30 and batch size to 128 to avoid tripping org quota. Also add exponential backoff with jitter on 429s (recommended: base=200ms, multiplier=2, max=10s, jitter=0.5).

mike_sre: I'll also run a short quota bump for that trial org (emergency) and open a ticket with capacity team to increase concurrency window for the quantized pool if needed.

ryan_billing: done — provisional lift applied: +100 concurrency for 1 hour for org acct_XXXX. Also will reconcile ledger so their invoices/usage map to the intended org to avoid 401s.

ben_infra: repro run started at 2387654350 — small script below. capturing rate-limit headers and worker queue lengths.

ben_infra: ```python
# repro snippet
for i in range(120):
    submit_batch(size=512, model='embed-large-v2')
# watch X-RateLimit-Remaining
```

ben_infra: capturing headers — observed pattern: 429s start when X-RateLimit-Remaining hits 0, reset window ~15s. Also spiky 401s when key rotation hits older credential before session finishes.

mike_sre: root cause summary: alias flip caused accidental model variant with different dims; customer switched billing org causing lower quota and intermittent auth mismatch; combined led to dimension errors (model mismatch) and rate-limited 429s + 401s.

sarah_support: messaging for customer: 1) pin model to canonical version to restore dims; 2) reduce concurrency/batch size and add jittered backoff; 3) we've temporarily boosted their quota while billing team fixes ledger; 4) followup to ensure alias rollback or explicit alias mapping at their side.

sarah_support: customer confirmed they pinned model and reduced concurrency, errors dropped to zero during their next run. They want us to keep the quota bump for 24h while they transition.

jenn_research: action items: revert experimental alias (or add clear docs on dimension changes), add guardrail that alias flips with dim changes emit an admin alert.

ryan_billing: I'll extend the provisional lift to 24h and coordinate org mapping.

mike_sre: closing loop — I'll file an internal postmortem about the alias rollout process and add a checklist to avoid silent dimension changes.

sarah_support: closing thread — marking as resolved with customer. :white_check_mark:
